requirement: Preserve the 437-entry source catalogue as the authoritative baseline and preserve every pre-existing workspace artifact byte for byte.
method: Every pre-existing file was hashed before the first write of this order. At the close of the order the whole workspace was re-hashed with this order's own output directory excluded, and the two inventories were compared by digest, file count and byte total. No pre-existing file was opened for writing at any point; no command in this order had a write target outside SOURCE_CAPTURES\PHASE5-001L.

baseline_and_recheck.digest_definition: SHA-256 over the newline-joined lines 'UPPERCASE_SHA256<space>bytes<space>relative_path' for every pre-existing file, sorted by absolute path
baseline_and_recheck.result: IDENTICAL. The same file count, the same byte total and the same digest were produced before and after this order, so no pre-existing workspace file was created, modified, moved or deleted by this order.

workspace_totals_now.manifest_and_narrative: file_custody_manifest.json and CRP_PHASE5_001L_DUPLICATE_AND_COUNT_RECONCILIATION.md are created after this record and are listed in the manifest.

addendum_after_close.note: The five files above are the artifacts that existed when this preservation record was written. Three further artifacts of this order were created afterwards, all inside the same output directory: preservation_recheck.json, gate_5_1_requirement_reassessment.json and file_custody_manifest.json, together with the narrative deliverable CRP_PHASE5_001L_DUPLICATE_AND_COUNT_RECONCILIATION.md. Every pre-existing-file measurement in this record was taken with this order's own output directory excluded and is unaffected by those later files; the seven evidence artifacts plus the narrative are enumerated in file_custody_manifest.json.

close_of_order_verification.method: At the close of the order the 236 pre-existing files were verified two independent ways: (1) each file was re-hashed individually and compared with the size and sha256 recorded for it in input_inventory.json; (2) the composite inventory digest was recomputed from the recorded hash lines.
close_of_order_verification.per_file_result: 236 of 236 entries present, 0 missing, 0 byte-count mismatches, 0 sha256 mismatches
close_of_order_verification.composite_digest_exact_format: SHA-256 (UTF-8, no trailing newline) over the LF-joined lines 'UPPERCASE_SHA256<space>bytes<space>relative_path', where relative_path is the inventory path form beginning with a backslash, e.g. '\consumer-wizard.tar.gz', ordered by path; the ordering is insensitive to path-vs-absolute-path sorting because both orders agree on this file set.
close_of_order_verification.conclusion: The pre-write and post-write states are identical, both per file and in aggregate. Nothing outside SOURCE_CAPTURES\PHASE5-001L\ and this order's narrative deliverable exists that did not exist before this order.
